name: PageCurlDragHandler3D
src_typeComment: Drop on a Collider covering ONE page's 3D drag zone (e.g. a BoxCollider matching the right page's Quad) — click-dragging across it turns the book. Use two of these, one per page, with `forward` set accordingly. Reads Input directly (not through the toolkit's Input Manager tools) to keep this self-contained — swap the raycast source if your project needs the new Input System instead.

src_serialized.name: forward
src_serialized.tooltip: True if this zone is the right page (drag turns forward); false for the left page (drag turns backward).

src_serialized.name: pageWidth
src_serialized.tooltip: Page width in local units — must match the associated page's actual width, used to convert a raycast hit point into 0-1 drag progress.

src_serialized.name: raycastCamera
src_serialized.tooltip: Camera used to raycast the mouse position. Defaults to Camera.main if left empty.
